_meta.note: Incentives snapshot for the Policy engine. Static JSON; update manually on change (TNB + MAV review), scraper polls announcements.

chert.note: Full import duty + excise + 50% SST exemption for CKD kits, full exemption for CBU imports

ev_road_tax.note: Special RM- annual flat rate; phased return to 10% of ICE from 2026 (RMDB5).

myev.note: GoM programmes: NEM 3.0 rooftop solar net metering, charging-point development incentives

ev_charging_grant.note: Individual income-tax relief up to RM2,500 for EV charging equipment (2023 onward)

hybrid.note: Hybrids: standard import duty + excise (CKD). No special EV incentives; road tax standard formula. Hybrid incentives were removed after 2022 for most models.

notes: Source: MAV + JPJ + Ministry of Finance announcements. Manual review on change.
